The Sparkling of Terapagos |plain_title=Pocket Monsters: The Sparkling of Terapagos |image=Pocket Monsters The Sparkling of Terapagos logo.png |size=240px |arc=Arc |number=2 |opening=Halo |ending=RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~ |numeps=20 ([[HZ026]]-[[HZ045]]) |region=[[Paldea]], [[Galar]] |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |prevlink=Liko and Roy's Departure |prev=Pocket Monsters: Liko and Roy's Departure |nextlink=Terastal Debut |next=Pocket Monsters: Terastal Debut |seo= }} (Japanese: '''テラパゴスのかがやき''' ''The Sparkling of Terapagos'') is the second arc of {{aniseries|HZ}}. It originally aired on [[TV Tokyo]] from October 27, 2023 to March 29, 2024. It is preceded by the ''[[Liko and Roy's Departure]]'' arc and followed by the ''[[Terastal Debut]]'' arc. This chapter focuses on the mysterious Pokémon {{p|Terapagos}} that emerges from [[Liko]]'s pendant, and the search for [[Lucius]]'s thought-to-be paradise [[Laqua]]. [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] learn about Lucius and the [[Six Heroes]] from [[Diana]], setting them on a quest to find the remaining members of Lucius's team, better known as the [[Six Heroes]]. The arc also features escalating confrontations with the [[Explorers]], who seek to capture the [[Black Rayquaza]], and introduces [[Gibeon]], the leader of the Explorers organization. The arc's opening theme is [[Halo]] performed by {{jwp|yama}} × {{jwp|ぼっちぼろまる|BotchiBoromaru}}, and the ending theme is [[RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~]] by Liko (CV: [[Minori Suzuki]]) & Roy (CV: [[Yuka Terasaki]]). {{spoilers}} ==Plot== After [[Pagogo|Terapagos]] emerges from its pendant form, [[Liko]] receives [[Lucius]]'s belt from her grandmother [[Diana]], who shares the legend of Lucius and his journey to [[Laqua]] with the [[Six Heroes]]. The [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] embark on a quest to find the remaining members of Lucius's team, discovering a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Lapras}} as the fourth member. During their journey, they encounter the [[Black Rayquaza]] multiple times, with Terapagos transforming into its {{form|Terapagos|Terastal Form}} for the first time during one of these encounters. The [[Explorers]] intensify their efforts to capture the Black Rayquaza, with [[Amethio]] training under [[Hamber]] and receiving a [[Tera Orb]]. [[Diana]] departs from the group to continue her own journey. During this period, [[Dot]] {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} a {{TP|Dot|Tinkatink}}, and the group meets [[Franka]], Dot's mother, who ultimately permits Dot to remain with the Rising Volt Tacklers. The arc reaches its climax when the Explorers launch their operation to capture the Black Rayquaza. The [[Brave Olivine]] suffers major damage during the confrontation, and [[Amethio]] uses {{Tera}}stallization for the first time while battling alongside the Rising Volt Tacklers against the Black Rayquaza. Despite their combined efforts, they are all defeated. [[Liko]]'s {{p|Sprigatito}} [[Evolution|evolves]] into {{TP|Liko|Floragato}} during the battle. The arc concludes with Liko, Roy, and Dot deciding to learn more about the Terastal phenomenon, while [[Gibeon]] orders his admins to continue monitoring Liko and Terapagos. Gibeon is revealed to own a {{Shiny}} [[White Zygarde|Zygarde]]. ==Gallery== ===Promotional material=== Pokémon Horizons Promotional Poster 3.jpg|First Key Visual Pokémon Horizons Promotional Poster
